steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: geom-baseline
steps.eval: window.__roomIds = window.__store.getState().floorPlan.rooms.map(r => r.id); window.__geomBaseline = window.__three.gl.info.memory.geometries; console.log('GEOMPROBE baseline=' + window.__geomBaseline + ' rooms=' + window.__roomIds.length)

steps.name: toggle-floor-finishes-30x
steps.eval: (async () => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const ids = window.__roomIds; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const mat = i % 2 === 0 ? 'floor-wood-walnut' : 'floor-wood-oak'; for (const r of ids) s.setFloorFinish(r, mat); await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 6)); } })()

steps.name: geom-after-toggle
steps.eval: window.__geomAfter = window.__three.gl.info.memory.geometries; console.log('GEOMPROBE after=' + window.__geomAfter + ' delta=' + (window.__geomAfter - window.__geomBaseline) + ' (BUG-002: must be ~0 — floor geometry is memoised + disposed, not leaked per render)')
